unverified_notes.topic: Home insurance premium at parcel level for 95014 and 94122
unverified_notes.reason: No official source publishes a ZIP- or parcel-level HO-3/DP-3 premium. California Department of Insurance publishes approved insurer rate filings and aggregate data-call results, not parcel quotes. NAIC publishes state-level HO-3 averages. Any parcel figure in this project is therefore a labelled planning assumption, not a verified value.

unverified_notes.topic: Exact Santa Clara County tax rate area (TRA) composite rate for ZIP 95014
unverified_notes.reason: Composite rates vary by tax rate area and require the Assessor's parcel number to look up. Privacy policy forbids recording the APN. The site models with the county's published typical TRA (1.1488%) and cross-checks against the user-supplied implied rate.
